products.body: From process colours to custom-matched brand shades — all low-odour, fast-drying and safe for food-grade packaging.

answers.shades: We stock 8 core water-based flexo shades — Signal Red, Solar Orange, Lemon Yellow, Forest Green, Cyan Sky, Cobalt Blue, Deep Violet and Magenta Rose. We also match custom brand colours to Pantone and our in-house shade cards.
answers.moq: Minimum order quantity depends on the shade and the pack or drum size. Tell us the colour, board and volume you need and we'll confirm what's available for you.
answers.foodSafe: Our water-based inks are low-VOC, low-odour and formulated to be low-migration for food-grade packaging — suitable for paper bags, liners and cartons.
answers.drying: The inks are built for high-speed flexo presses on corrugated, kraft and coated boards — fast drying, high coverage and a consistent shade batch after batch.
answers.delivery: We dispatch from Hyderabad across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Odisha, Kerala, Chhattisgarh and PAN India. Share your location and volume and we'll confirm the lead time.
answers.pricing: Pricing depends on the shade, quantity and pack size. Send us your requirement and we'll share a quotation quickly.
answers.sample: We'd be glad to send a shade card or sample. Share your name, company and the shades you're interested in, and we'll arrange it.
